title: Seemed sharp but to clunky
text: Seemed sharp but to clunky. Big and cumbersome for a veggie peeler and it was delivered with parts missing. I'll stick to using a pairing knife.

product_metadata.title: AmDONGKING Safety Can Opener Smooth Edge with Bottle Opener, Professional Stainless Steel Ergonomic Soft Grip Handle Kitchen Cans Opener, Dishwasher Safe.
features: 【Ergonomic Design】The ergonomic non-slip design allows for smooth cutting when opening cans without the hand slipping, it is great for seniors with arthritis Hands. The Single handle can opener “No Clamp” design. Uses modern safety opener technology to unseal and remove the can lid. Result is a smooth edge.

【Easy to Use】This side cutting safety can opener is quite simple to operate. The easy to turn non-slip turning knob makes it so anyone can use this manual can opener. You no longer have to worry about cutting yourself when opening cans with the smooth edge cutting safety mechanism.
【Durable Construction】Premium quality material with stainless steel constructed design and rubber handle make AmDONGKING can opener easy to wash, manually or in the dishwasher.

【Great For opening cans】If a manual can opener could ever be fun to use, this safety can opener is it. Great for the family and great for projects with the kids. A great conversation starter. A great gift. Looks great suitable for any occasion such as Weddings, Christmas, and Housewarming Parties.
